description: A Linux kernel hardware monitoring (hwmon) driver for the Gateworks System Controller, interfacing via I2C, defining sensor registers, driver initialization, and sysfs interface.

methods.name: gsp_probe
methods.description: Initializes the hwmon device, sets up sysfs entries, and registers the device with the I2C subsystem.

methods.name: gsp_remove
methods.description: Cleans up and unregisters the hwmon device and sysfs entries.

methods.name: gsp_init
methods.description: Registers the I2C driver during module initialization.

methods.name: gsp_exit
methods.description: Unregisters the I2C driver during module cleanup.
